contracts.title: Shot + Touches + Coach Run Plays/POE/Freelance → Player FGA share
contracts.hypothesis: A one-field-at-a-time change in the governed shot-creation configuration might change core scorer native shot participation after minute/context adjustment; sign and threshold remain unproven.
competing_explanations: Role Tier Branch C raw bytes missing from forensic receipt
Touches not equivalent to Shot or native USG%
ACE overrides and unmatched PlayTypes/playbook CRC
Lineup, defensive matchup and player ratings
contracts.metric_source_policy: GAME_NATIVE_CALCULATED_SAME_GRAIN_FIRST; current exact PC22 Advanced field requires independent read-only proof; do not use an estimated metric by default
contracts.minimum_unit: game+player within same save and matched opponent, with per-game FGA and actual minutes

stages.name: S0_BASELINE
stages.method: Record same-save exact field/native and PC22 UI before values twice, stable opponent/context and game-native outcome baseline. No writing by Stage02.

stages.name: S1_INTERVENTION
stages.method: Only after separate Human authority: one-factor REA Setter in designated safe save, independent immediate native readback, invariant-field readback, recorded original value, rollback and post-rollback confirmation. Abort on mismatch.

stages.name: S2_OBSERVATION
stages.method: Later collect comparable multiple real games, native game-calculated statistics first; distinguish 3D and Calendar Sim, observe original box and any Advanced native label, no assumed telemetry source.

stages.name: S3_EVALUATION
stages.method: Pre-register direction/contrast and uncertainty; compare within stratum and comparable opponents, report SUPPORTS_HYPOTHESIS / DOES_NOT_SUPPORT / INCONCLUSIVE / NEED_EVIDENCE without causal production rule.

controls: same save_instance, build, player/team/game IDs, and real game phase
3D_CPU_CPU, CALENDAR_SIM, USER_VS_CPU, SimCast treated as separate strata
quarter_length and sim_quarter_length recorded independently
normalize_stats and normalize_played_minutes distinct, UNKNOWN if not read
opponent, roster, game venue, injuries, substitutions and actual minutes
ACE runtime overrides, coach gameplan and true active freelance separated
native Player Card/Box/Advanced metric definition, original precision and freshness

comparison.design: paired or blocked quasi-experimental by opponent and roster; isolate one selected field change per contrast
comparison.sample: Several games in each stratum, justified by observed variance and feasible power. N>=10 alone never proves comparability.
comparison.baseline: S0 identity, settings, native metric label and exact source readback
comparison.readback: S1 modified field and invariant fields independent REA read-only confirmation after authorization
comparison.success: Aligned native outcome direction within comparable stratum with credible interval/uncertainty, stable field mapping and recorded confounders
comparison.failure: No consistent within-mode FGA-share direction under matched controls; no proof for deterministic ceiling or automatic Shot formula.
comparison.unknown: Any missing exact native event/advanced source, mismatch or inadequate control is INCONCLUSIVE or NEED_EVIDENCE
comparison.operational_rule: Never auto-propose production tuning from these pilot results

contracts.title: Tempo + POE + rotation → native Pace/transition/stamina
contracts.hypothesis: Coach Tempo may alter possessions/transition under some engine modes, but submitted 10–70 clamp is static disassembly lead and not a measured game pace law.
competing_explanations: Calendar Sim and 3D pace mechanisms may differ
Game length and normalized stats obscure pace
AI injury/fatigue may override rotation minutes
Single stamina snapshot cannot establish fatigue rate
contracts.metric_source_policy: GAME_NATIVE_CALCULATED_SAME_GRAIN_FIRST; current exact PC22 Advanced field requires independent read-only proof; do not use an estimated metric by default
contracts.minimum_unit: team game plus clock-anchored player stamina observations if source exists

contracts.title: HelpDefense + defensive POE + personal defense → protection and leakage
contracts.hypothesis: Different defensive assistance could change opponent rim/arc attempts, but no fixed sign, success rate or precise help-rotation implementation is proven.
competing_explanations: Defender ratings and on-ball personal instructions
ACE or opponent offensive system override
Rim shot zone native source may not exist
